name: services/slips/templates

arguments.name: fields
arguments.description: Pipe-separated list of informational fields/sections you're interested in. This must be any subset of keys, which are described in the returns section of the template method.

arguments.name: question_fields
arguments.description: Deprecated. Same as in the question method.

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.

returns:
A dictionary. Template IDs will be mapped to keys of this dictionary. Each value will be a dictionary of the same structure as described in the template method.

For all invalid references, the value will be null (instead of a dictionary).
